noQbModel: There is no QB prospect model. The page covers WR, RB and TE by scope decision, not as a pending gap.

WR.label: Base Model
WR.blurb: Raw model output: adjusted production, career efficiency and draft capital, with no athletic or competition adjustment applied.

WR.label: Fast-40 Dock
WR.blurb: Base model with the sub-4.33 forty adjustment applied to draft capital (a burner's draft slot is discounted 40%).

WR.label: Final Model
WR.blurb: The fast-40 version plus a 20% penalty for a non-Power-conference prospect or a sub-.55 final-season SOS taken inside the first two rounds. The sheet labels this column the final model.

RB.label: Model Result
RB.blurb: Full model: schedule- and age-adjusted yards-after-contact production, receiving usage and draft capital.

RB.label: Without Best Season
RB.blurb: The same model with each prospect's best season removed -- a leave-one-out check on whether a grade rests on one outlier year.

TE.label: With SPORQ Bonus
TE.blurb: Pre-combine model plus the athletic bonus: 20% for a 90+ SPORQ, 5% penalty below the threshold. Prospects with no SPORQ score fall back to the pre-combine grade.

TE.label: Pre-Combine
TE.blurb: Production, efficiency and draft capital only, before any athletic testing is applied.

poolBasis.all: every prospect at this position in the model, all classes
poolBasis.class: prospects at this position in his own draft class
